en-US.description: The infinite canvas for orchestrating AI agents.
en-US.longDescription:
Maestri is an infinite-canvas desktop app for orchestrating AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, or plain shells). Agents run in terminals placed as nodes on the canvas and can talk to each other directly.

What's on the canvas:
- Teamwork — connect terminals together and let agents prompt each other directly; one agent can delegate tasks, ask questions, or hand off work.
- Roles — create reusable roles with custom instructions and assign them to agents; each agent knows exactly what to do.
- A chat face for every terminal — ask in a message and get answers with formatted text, diagrams, tables, and files you can drag onto the canvas.
- An edgeless canvas — pan freely, zoom in on the agent that needs attention, zoom out for the full picture, and group related work.
- Portals — embedded browser, Android emulator, and physical device views on the canvas.
- Floors — isolated workspace copies for context switching, with WSL/SSH/Docker support.
en-US.name: Maestri
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's New in Maestri 0.30.7
Improved
- More reliable session restore for Claude Code and Codex.
Fixed
- Keep remote processes alive works on SSH, Docker and Sandbox terminals whose tmux was installed with Homebrew, Linuxbrew, Nix or in ~/.local/bin.
- maestri commands work in SSH terminals on servers whose login shell is zsh.

zh-CN.description: 编排 AI 智能体的无限画布。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Maestri 是一个无限画布桌面应用，用于编排 AI 编码智能体（Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 或普通 shell）。智能体在画布上以终端节点的形式运行，可以直接相互对话。

画布上有什么：
- 团队协作 — 把终端连接起来，让智能体直接相互提示；一个智能体可以委派任务、提问或交接工作。
- 角色 — 创建带自定义指令的可复用角色并分配给智能体；每个智能体都清楚自己该做什么。
- 每个终端都有聊天界面 — 用消息提问，即可获得带排版文本、图表、表格的答案，还能把文件拖到画布上。
- 无边际画布 — 自由平移，放大需要关注的智能体，缩小查看全局，并按工作内容分组。
- 门户 — 画布上的嵌入式浏览器、Android 模拟器和实体设备视图。
- 楼层（Floors） — 用于切换上下文的隔离工作区副本，支持 WSL/SSH/Docker。
